cases.tolerance_rationale: Deterministic; the skill rounds to 1 decimal: half a unit of the last decimal.

source.citation: Independent calculation in R, without running the skill (verificacion_referencias_conapesca.Rmd), on the curated CONAPESCA database (snapshot 2026-08-07).

cases.notes: Uses the inputs year_from / year_to (SKILL.md 0.2.0). Trivial case: the office has no COSECHA (100 %). OFFICE PROXY: CABO SAN LUCAS stands in for the Cabo Pulmo MPA because the skill resolves by landing office. The verified value tests the computation, not the representativeness of the office. Cases will be redefined when the skill estimates at MPA level (major version bump).

input.description: La Paz landing office (BCS), all species, 2016–2025; share of capture (MAYORES + MENORES) in total volume. Non-trivial case: the office has COSECHA in every year of the period.

cases.tolerance_rationale: Deterministic; the skill rounds to 1 decimal: half a unit of the last decimal.

source.citation: Independent calculation in R, without running the skill (verificacion_la_paz_composicion.R), on the curated CONAPESCA database (snapshot 2026-08-07): capture 55,981.94 t and 1,565,040,039 MXN; aquaculture 26,413.13 t and 2,606,122,035 MXN. Cross-checked with the CONAPESCA MCP (base v0.0.4), get_landings(oficina='LA PAZ', estado='BAJA CALIFORNIA SUR', tipo_aviso, group_by='year') summed over 2016-2025: same percentages (67.9433 and 37.5205).

data_snapshot.db_version: Delivery CONAPESCA 2026-06-29 (request 340008100012626), curated with conapesca-database; MCP base v0.0.4 (conapesca_landings_2001_2026_2026-08-07.rds)

cases.notes: Second case requested in the engineering review (CC-5): non-trivial, the office has COSECHA in every year of 2016-2025 (3,421 COSECHA, 357 MAYORES and 80,834 MENORES records). Capture weighs 67.9 % of volume but 37.5 % of value (aquaculture is worth more per kg). OFFICE PROXY: LA PAZ stands in for the Espíritu Santo MPA; the verified value tests the computation, not the representativeness of the office.
